items.title: PM2 works with Node, it'll work with npm. Right? ❌ Wrong.
items.description: A common PM2 pitfall: running pm2 start npm causes signal handling failures, port conflicts, and restart loops. Fix: npm run build && pm2 start dist/index.js

items.title: Quick hack to survive memory crashes without upgrading your instance
items.description: Enabled swap on a t3.micro GitHub Actions runner to handle Flutter + Node CI build memory spikes. Saved $7.50/month by not upgrading to t3.small.

items.title: A Beginner's Guide: How to Report Vulnerabilities on Government Digital Services using CERT-In's RVDCP
